one_liner: Consensus offers a self-serve REST scholarly paper search API (free tier of 30 calls/month) keyed by x-api-key, plus a vendor-hosted MCP server at mcp.consensus.app/mcp that supports API-key bearer and OAuth 2.0 PKCE.
auth_notes: REST API (api.consensus.app): API key in the x-api-key header only. OAuth 2.0 authorization-code + PKCE (S256, scope 'search', DCR public clients) is documented for the MCP server, not the REST API; Bearer is for MCP only. No client-credentials grant. Confidential OAuth clients are provisioned manually for enterprise partners via sales.
access_notes: Every plan including Free gets API access via a key from the API & MCP Dashboard; Free has 30 calls/month, 1 req/s, 20 papers per request, no pagination, full-text excerpts, citations, or complete text. API and MCP share one monthly pool.
blocker_notes: Free quota is small (30 calls/month) and several features need a paid plan; API surface is narrow (search, full text, citations/references beta, threads).

evidence.quote: Pass the key in the `x-api-key` header. Requests without a valid key return `401`.
`Authorization: Bearer` is for the MCP server (`mcp.consensus.app/mcp`), not the REST API.
Authorization-code flow only. There is no client-credentials grant, so OAuth always involves a per-user consent step; each user signs in to their own Consensus account.
Every plan includes API access, and the Free plan includes 30 calls a month.
The API is self-serve on every Consensus plan.
The Consensus API lets you search 400+ million scholarly articles, including 350 million peer-reviewed research papers, over a single REST endpoint.
Prefer a no-code path? Connect Consensus to Claude, ChatGPT, and other MCP clients.
Everything on this page applies to any MCP client or gateway.
